ya5.2.1:203.1: Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayas. nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ dukkhas. nuppajjati; aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ samudayas. ca nuppajjissati, dukkhas. ca nuppajjati.
ya5.2.1:204.1: Yassa dukkhas. nuppajjati, tassa maggas. nuppajjissatīti?
ya5.2.1:205.1: Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe ye c' aññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhas. nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ maggas. nuppajjissati; aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesan cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ dukkhas. ca nuppajjati, maggas. ca nuppajjisati.
ya5.2.1:206.1: Yassa vā pana maggas. nuppajjissati, tassa dukkhas. nuppajjatīti?
ya5.2.1:207.1: Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ uppajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggas. nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ dukkhas. nuppajjati; aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesan maggas. ca nuppajjissati, dukkhas. ca nuppajjati.
ya5.2.1:208.1: Yassa samudayas. nuppajjati, tassa maggas. nuppajjissatīti?
ya5.2.1:209.1: Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa uppādakkhaṇe ye c' aññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte pavattamāne nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesan samudayas. uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ maggas. nupajjissati; aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte pavattamāne nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ samudayas. ca nuppajjati, maggas. ca nuppajjissati.
ya5.2.1:211.1: Ye puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ maggas. nuppajjissati, no ca t. samudayas. nuppajjati; aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte pavattamāne nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ t. maggas. . . . samudayas. ca nuppajjati. ii.
ya5.2.1:213.1: Y. y. dukkhas. nuppajjati, t. t. samudayas. nuppajjissatīti?
ya5.2.1:214.1: Catuvokārā pañcavokārā cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha dukkhas. nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayas. nuppajjissati, aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha dukkhas . . . samudayas. ca nuppajjissati.
ya5.2.1:216.1: Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa uppādakkhaṇe asaññasattaṃ uppajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayas. nuppajjissati, no ca t. t. dukkhas. nuppajjati; aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arūpe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe asaññasattā cavantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayas. . . . dukkhas. ca nuppajjati.

ya5.2.1:220.1: Aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti, tesaṃ uppajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe asaññasattaṃ uppajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggas. nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dukkhas nuppajjati; aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ cittassa . . . ya5.2.1:222.1: Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa uppādakkhaṇe ye c' aññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti, tesaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte pavattamāne tesaṃ tattha samudayas. nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggas. nuppajjissati; aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte pavattamāne asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayas. . . . maggas. canuppajjissati.
ya5.2.1:224.1: Āpāyikānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya uppādakkhaṇe t. t. maggas. nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayas. nuppajjati; aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggan na paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ taṇhāya bhaṅgakkhaṇe taṇhāvippayuttacitte pavattamāne asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggas. ca nuppajjissati, samudayas. ca nuppajjati. 11. i.
ya5.2.1:225.1: Yassa dukkhas. uppajjittha, tassa samudayas. uppajjissatīti?
ya5.2.1:226.1: Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti, tesaṃ dukkhas. uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ samudayas. uppajjissati; jitaresaṃ dukkhas. ca uppajjittha, samudayas. ca uppajjissati.
ya5.2.1:228.1: Yassa dukkhas. uppajjittha, tassa maggas. uppajjissatīti?
ya5.2.1:229.1: Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ ye ca putujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti, tesaṃ dukkhas. uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ maggas. uppajjissati; yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa uppādakkhaṇe ye c' aññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ dukkhas. . . . maggas. ca uppajjissati.
